name: loadout
description: Route prompts to relevant skills through the loadout hook in Claude Code CLI, and attach loadout's library search (find_tools, load_skill); desktop app Code tab: not yet tested. Requires loadout on PATH and Node 22.12+. Every routed prompt, with the repository's top-level file names and dependency names, goes to TypeSafe's Jev API; setting "router": "lexical" keeps prompts local.
